knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The owners corporation buys the outcome, stated as a standard it can check, with certainty that it will be delivered. The hourly rate, equipment and business age are not the outcome.
A return-visit promise must be something you can deliver and afford. The lesson says to limit it to a promise you control, such as a return visit within a stated time.
A measurable claim must be backed by evidence that supports it. The lesson says not to publish a measured claim unless you can show the inspection record.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
